main_topics.reason: The user came to learn what migraine preventatives exist and spent most turns comparing newer injectable and oral options.
The user asked what the older options are and whether a neurologist would try them before the newer drug.
The user asked directly about side effects and precautions of the oral drug in one exchange.
The user raised insurance as a wild card and asked whether older drugs must fail first, which took a couple of turns.
The stated goal was to go to the next visit prepared, and the user asked for a short question list near the end.
The condition is only background context for the treatment discussion.

output.summary: The user has chronic migraine and wanted to understand preventative options before a neurologist visit. The bot covered injectable and oral CGRP drugs, older oral preventatives, insurance step therapy and a list of questions to bring. The user said it was exactly what they needed and planned to ask about the oral drug the bot called migraxone.
